name: bodesign
description: AI PCB design copilot — ingest a KiCad/EDA project folder, plan requirements, source reference evidence, generate KiCad symbols/schematics, lay out + export fab files, and track readiness, validated against KiCad and a known-good reference (control group). Runs as a Docker container; MCP Streamable HTTP over a Unix socket with a token file API.
instructions:
bodesign is an AI PCB design copilot. Since v0.2.0 its surface has THREE classes (R13.5):

1) COMPUTE TOOLS (this MCP server, prefix `bodesign_`): the heavy toolchain a host cannot run — KiCad schematic/layout/fab (emit_symbol, compose_schematic, emit_layout, route_net2pcb, via_in_pad, pour_planes, widen_bus_tracks, length_match_bus, layout_drc_gate, autoroute, emit_fab, export_bom, export_netlist), verification (simulate, si_check, analyze_emc, analyze_thermal, analyzer_selfcheck), CAD/render (c02_export_stl/skp/step, c02_render_enclosure, c02_project_svg, c02_voice_to_design, render_board_model, render_gerber_preview, render_companion, emit_doc, dxf_to_dwg/dwg_to_dxf), the server-side component vault (vault_*), spice_model_card, c01_generate_concept_image, MCP delegation (mcp_call), the token file API (stage_dir), and the deliverable-cache lifecycle (cache_provision/export/close). GET /tools and /tools/{name} for the authoritative, current schemas.

2) LANDING VERBS (NOT MCP tools — run them on the HOST): the ~52 deterministic project-folder verbs — C00 PRD family, C01 ID family, C02 analysis, C03 emitters, C04/C05/C06 scaffold+readiness, the whole orchestration spine, ingest_project/package_readiness/datasheet gates, and pure functions (impedance_solve, pin_allocation, reference_crosscheck, plan_design_intent, evidence_manifest) — run directly on the caller's machine via the bodesign skill's gate.py, writing straight into the project repo with zero token round-trip:
  python3 <bodesign-skill>/scripts/gate.py <verb> --repo /abs/project [--json '{...}' | --arg k=v]
  python3 <bodesign-skill>/scripts/gate.py --list   # enumerate every landing verb
Calling a landed name as an MCP tool returns a typed TOOL_LANDED error carrying the equivalent gate.py command — it is not an unknown tool.

3) CACHE LIFECYCLE (batch file exchange for heavy flows): bodesign_cache_provision (idempotent per owner+subject; returns cache token + /dav/{token}/ mount URL + a WebDAV Basic credential) -> mount with rclone/davfs2 or PUT over WebDAV -> run compute tools against the cache tree -> bodesign_cache_export (land the whole tree to a host dir) -> bodesign_cache_close (dirty-gated: typed WORKSPACE_CLOSE_DIRTY unless exported or force=true). For small one-shot trees the token file model still works: POST /files (tarball) or bodesign_stage_dir -> pass `token` to any tool (path args resolve inside its doc_dir) -> GET /files/{token}/blob/{rel}.

PAIRS WITH the companion `bodesign` skill (the C00-C07 workflow brain + the kicad/kidoc analysis+doc engines + gate.py). The skill drives these tools to generate; the verification tools (simulate/analyze_emc/analyze_thermal) call the skill's engines back via BODESIGN_KICAD_SKILL / BODESIGN_SPICE_SKILL / BODESIGN_EMC_SKILL (self-bundled in the container image under /opt/bodesign-engines).

The server is reachable over the UDS socket and TCP HTTP at http://<host>:8077/mcp/ (same API; the container publishes both).

No send-to-fab output without deterministic validation + explicit user approval. Reliability is shown by cross-check vs a known-good reference (control group), not asserted.

USAGE GUIDE: this service self-ships its full usage doctrine — call bodesign_init (or prompts/get bodesign_init) for the two-plane routing model (landing verbs via gate.py vs bodesign_ compute tools), the honesty/no-fallback contract, pre-call disciplines (refs_ingest step 0, DoD self-verify), organ coordination (bodesign skill + container + UDS/TCP transport + cache 3-tier + webdav), and counter-intuitive gotchas before first use.

DOMAIN KB (R16): bodesign self-ships its PCB-design domain KB — call bodesign_kb_query(q) before judgment-heavy design steps (layout, EMC, SI, derating) to recall distilled design rules, IPC tables and failure modes; bodesign_kb_get(id) returns the full body.
